name: M'ONDUNIQ HI'FUsion Longevity hydrating and smoothing anti-wrinkle face cream
shortDescription: Rich, comfortable-textured hydrating and smoothing face cream with hyaluronic acid, hydrolyzed silk and shea butter – in the spirit of the Longevity philosophy. 150 ml.
description:
A rich, comfortable-textured hydrating and smoothing face cream that helps preserve the skin's optimal hydration, softness and elasticity. Designed in the spirit of the Longevity philosophy, the formula supports daily skincare while giving the skin a smoother, fresher and more radiant appearance.

Its carefully selected ingredients help maintain a healthy, well-cared-for skin appearance and skin comfort. Despite its rich texture, it feels pleasant on the skin and leaves it smooth and soft without weighing it down.
metaTitle: M'ONDUNIQ HI'FUsion Longevity Ultra anti-wrinkle face cream
metaDescription: Hydrating and smoothing anti-wrinkle face cream with hyaluronic acid, hydrolyzed glycosaminoglycans, silk and shea butter. Does not weigh the skin down. 150 ml.
